title: Installed framework manifest (.sta/manifest.json)
description: T92/T94 — a project's own copy of templates/manifest.json, written by `sta init` and kept current by `sta upgrade`/`migrate`/`rollback`. `sha256` here is the *pristine framework* hash for each file (what the framework last shipped), not necessarily what's on disk right now — a project may have edited the file since. Comparing this against the file's live hash is exactly what tells upgrade a file is safe to overwrite versus user-modified. `schema_version` is this manifest's own shape version, separate from `framework_version` (which framework release installed it) and from any knowledge/state schema version elsewhere in the project (T94's point: three different things that change independently).
